programme.title: The Block
programme.sub-title: Front Yard and Facade (Whole House) Reveal
programme.desc: Couples compete to renovate properties under strict deadlines and budgets in a high-stakes reality contest. Their finished homes are auctioned, with profits determining the winners in a dramatic finale.
